Class CPUPlayer

java.lang.Object
agent.Player
agent.cpu.CPUPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Comparable<Player>
public class CPUPlayer extends Player
Represents the CPUPlayer which extends Player. CPUPlayer can perform all actions that a Player can do.
